_comment: Adani Green Energy S7 (300 MW) - project configuration. Read by the data builder (dash_data.py: calendar, vocabulary, paths) and published to the page as DATA.cfg (labels, procurement columns). Never put API tokens here - they live in the gitignored scripts/vl_tokens.json / Actions secrets.
_relations_comment: built from the P6 XER (FY26-P14 S7 27.08.2026.xer) by scripts/build_relations_from_xer.py. VisiLean returns prerequisites empty, so the schedule file is the only place the logic lives. Endpoints are activity codes (P6 task_code = VisiLean externalId); dash_data.py resolves them to uids. 8,149 links, all endpoints resolved, 99.9% of leaves wired in.

calendar._comment: day 1 of the working-day axis = earliest planned start in VisiLean (05-Jan-2026). 6-day week, Sunday off, as for S6a.

_baselineMode_comment: no baseline dates on any of the 2,300 leaves (checked 08-Sep-2026), so VisiLean planned dates ARE the baseline and rows are not flagged un-baselined. Switch to 'visilean' once a baseline is set there.
_levelsFromChain_comment: this project publishes no 'Level N' custom fields (only Parent WBS), so the levels are read off the parent chain with the project root dropped. That lands Level 1 on the same grouping S6a's Level 1 held (CONSTRUCTION & COMMISIONING, PROCUREMENT, ENGINEERING, HOTO ...), so the department map, area rule and package rule below carry over unchanged.
_activityType_comment: the project's own Activity Type values are already the ones the EPC card counts (Construction, Procurement - Supply, Procurement - Services, Engineering); Handover, Pre-Construction and Milestone pass through to the card's 'other activity types' line, so no map is needed.

departments._comment: VisiLean 'Department' custom field -> dashboard department key; 'Dept/Level2-prefix' splits a department on Level 2

_departments_comment: keyed on WBS Level 1 (from the parent chain). The Dept/Level2-prefix split sends the 25 CLEARANCES & APPROVALS rows - PPA, grid connectivity, CEA - to Regulatory & Statutory instead of Initiation.
_nullLevels_comment: this P6 export writes a literal '0' where a WBS level is unused (171 rows at Level 3, 953 at Level 4); treated as empty so it never becomes a package or section name
_area_comment: areas are the 19 blocks across 5 phases; the block number is read from WBS Level 3 ('BLOCK-15'). Procurement and engineering rows carry no block and fall to 'Off-site / Office'.
_packageFromField_comment: the 'Package' custom field holds the Level-2 group (PHASE-4 (50MW), PROCUREMENT- ORDERING & DELIVERY), not a package, so packages come from the WBS levels: Level 3 for procurement ('MODULE (IMPORTED FROM CHINA)', 'MC4 CONNECTOR' - 37 of them), the deepest work package for execution
_steps_comment: procurement activities are named '<Package>-<Step>-Lot-NN', so every key here is matched as a substring of the normalised name
longLead: module|inverter|idt|ht cable|ht panel|lt panel|scada|robotic|dc cable|fiber optic|mms
_reg_comment: this project has no Regulatory & Statutory department in VisiLean, so the approvals trackers have nothing to key on
_countSummaries_comment: the count-summary cards, as on NTPC. The PO pair counts the LOI / PO Release step (37 packages). This schedule has no separate acceptance step - its engineering activities ARE the drawings - so the document pair counts those, with wording set by the accept* keys below.
_procDatesCard_comment: as on NTPC: the pipeline table replaces the Key Procurement Dates matrix on the procurement pages. Set true to bring the matrix back (procDateCols is still configured).
_actionsRunsApi_comment: best-effort, public API: lets the Refresh button say whether this project's sync worker is running. Purely informational - the click always reloads.
_engStage_comment: engStage takes single keyword/label pairs (unlike procStage, which takes key lists)
_pipeColFrom_comment: procurement activities are named <Package>-<Step>-Lot-NN, so the pipeline matrix is keyed on the sub-stage (Spec/Tender/PO/Mfg/Dispatch/Transit/At Site) instead of the activity name
_spelling_comment: the schedule spells some steps inconsistently ('Purchase Requistion', 'Receipt For Site', 'Receipt Site At'); every variant is matched
acceptHint: every engineering deliverable in this view - this schedule has no separate Final Acceptance step, each activity is the drawing itself - completed vs what the baseline says should be complete today
_execStage_comment: S6a's work-type keys matched 1,440 of 1,560 construction rows; the 120 left are the per-block CEA approvals, COD and Trial Operation, added to the T&C bucket. 'cod' and the three 'cea*' keys were checked project-wide for false positives (none).
_longLead_comment: the big-ticket packages among the 37 in PROCUREMENT- ORDERING & DELIVERY
_quantityFields_comment: KP 22-Sep: the real planned / actual quantity and unit live in these custom fields (384 construction rows). VisiLean's own totalQuantity / quantityUnits carry a placeholder - 100 'Units' on 1,844 rows with no measured scope - and its actualQuantity disagrees with the field the team maintains on 29 rows, so the custom fields are read instead and a row without them carries no quantity.
_blockDrill_comment: as S6a: a block tile, its totals strip and any package bar open the activities behind them. S7 publishes the same Construction Fields / Construction sub Field custom fields - 360 activities across 10 packages - so the per-package breakdown has real content.
_blockSummary_comment: as S6a: an all-blocks total above the block scorecard
_vlLabel_comment: as S6a: KP reads 'Not Ready' as not started - it is 410 of S7's activities
_vlHide_comment: as S6a: the QC / ready states this client's projects never use are dropped from the status legend. Warning and Stopped stay, as on S6a, so an activity that lands in one is still explained. Hiding only affects the legend - a chip on a row always renders.

siteModel._comment: Real plant geometry from the issued array layout 51BY-KPIG-ARY-BES-DE-L-0001 OVERALL PLANT ARRAY LAYOUT R06 06.03.2026, sheet 2 (overall plant array layout), built by scripts/build_site_from_layout.py. The sheet carries named CAD layers, so each element is read off its own layer: Plant Road / Road / 5.2MW WTG Road, 33kV and 400kV TL Corridor, Boundary-Khavda Park, EPC Boundary, Boundary-MW Cluster, No Go Area and 5.2MW WTG-AGEL. On the ICR Grouping layer each block outline is a chain of hair-thin filled bands whose ring is split across several drawing groups, so the block polygons are the cycles of that layer after welding endpoints, traced by taking the next edge clockwise so the corners where blocks touch split the way they are drawn. All 24 ICRs close on the drawing as issued; no outline is inferred or repaired. Georeferenced from the sheet's own surveyed E/N callouts (residual 0.90 m E / 0.04 m N at 1.17 m per point). Row pitch and table size come from the pile grid on the detail sheets. Metres; x east, y north, origin at the model's south-west corner.
